# Will your bank accept this SEPA XML file?

> Free SEPA XML checker for pain.001 credit transfer and pain.008 direct debit files: recomputes NbOfTxs and CtrlSum, checks IBAN and BIC, EUR, TARGET2 execution dates, field lengths and the SEPA character set, and repairs the totals. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
